# provider-runtime — LLM doc index (pinned: v1.3.0)
# One line per file; regenerate the pin on release.
docs/index.md: the map of this bundle
docs/overview.md: package design and the managed-resource reconcile flow
docs/usage.md: go get + the minimal code to build a provider on this library
docs/configuration.md: build tags, OTel SDK environment, option structs and runtime annotations
docs/api.md: the exported Go API surface, package by package, plus metric instruments
docs/examples.md: examples index
docs/release.md: tag-only release runbook (v-prefixed git tags, Go module proxy)
docs/log.md: curated history
docs/design-rate-limit-governor.md: design (implemented, off by default) for slow-down under server-side rate limits and controller CPU/memory saturation
docs/design-scale-to-zero.md: design (implemented, unreleased) for owners to run a per-Kind controller Deployment at 0 replicas while its Kind is empty
pkg/scaletozero/scaletozero.go: Exists, Decide and Reconcile, the scale-to-zero helper owners call (live reader required; nothing else may write spec.replicas)
pkg/ratelimit/signal.go: the rate-limit Signal, Report and the context sink
pkg/ratelimit/governor.go: the per-key governor and its non-blocking Acquire
pkg/ratelimit/saturation.go: the cgroup v2 saturation sampler (local capacity)
pkg/ratelimit/queue.go: the gated queue: the local slot is taken before the pop and given back in Done
docs/design-local-slot-before-pop.md: design (implemented) for taking the local slot before the pop
docs/design-saturation-cost-model.md: design (decided, not built) for sizing local capacity from what reconciles cost against the container's CPU and memory limits
pkg/ratelimit/httpsignal/httpsignal.go: http.RoundTripper reporting GitHub and Azure DevOps rate-limit headers, and propagating the active span's traceparent
pkg/tracing/decide.go: Decide, the krateo.io/traceparent parent-or-link rule, and Canonical
pkg/tracing/start.go: StartReconcile (the reconcile root span, always a new root), StartStep (its children) and StartActStep (the first act for a new value, in the upstream trace)
pkg/tracing/inject.go: Inject, InjectAnnotations and InjectHeader, with the rules for callers
pkg/telemetry/setup.go: Config, ConfigFromEnv and Setup, the OTLP metrics and trace pipelines over one resource
pkg/reconciler/ratelimit.go: RateLimitKeyer, RateLimitKeysProvider, WithRateLimitGovernor and the deferral path
pkg/reconciler/traces.go: the reconcile's tracing: the memo, the per-pass state, the locked marker write, WithTracerProvider and WithTraceContinueWindow
pkg/reconciler/reconcilertest/ratelimit.go: AssertReportsRateLimits, the conformance helper for providers
examples/greeting-controller/README.md: minimal compilable provider (Greeting CRD + fake external system)
examples/greeting-controller/main.go: the example source
examples/greeting-controller/crd.yaml: the Greeting CRD
examples/greeting-controller/greeting.yaml: a sample Greeting CR
docs/design-tracing.md: design (built in v1.14.0, D8 in v1.14.1) for OpenTelemetry reconcile traces: telemetry.Setup's TracerProvider, the reconcile span and its children, the krateo.io/traceparent parent-or-link rule, and outbound propagation
